newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Komag drops.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Komag drops.

text.p: Shares in Komag Inc fell before Thursday's market opening, hit by its warning that results for the second quarter and the rest of the year would fall short of expectations.
Traders said the San Jose, Calif., company's shares were trading at 18-1/8 after closing at 23-9/16 Wednesday.

The company, a maker of thin-film media used to store data on computer hard disks, said it expected to earn less in its second quarter ending June 28 than the $0.33 a share it made in the first quarter.
Analysts had expected Komag to earn $0.45 a share in the second quarter. Komag also said earnings would be less in the second half of the year than in the first half.
Komag blamed the fall on weak demand.
Atmel Corp was trading at 24-5/8 from a Wednesday close of 26-5/16 after it said its second-quarter results would be below expectations.
Apria Healthcare Group Inc was trading at 18-1/4 from a closing price of 17-13/16 after the company said it had hired an adviser on the possible merger or sale of the company.

France's Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc was being bid at 90-1/2 from a closing price of 79-7/16. The parent company, Rhone-Poulenc, said it was considering a $4.3 billion bid to buy the rest of Rhone-Poulenc Rorer, its U.S. unit.
